name: Kyle
title: Street Samurai
core_contradiction: A warrior of honor surviving in a world that punishes honor. Samurai means discipline, dignity, service. Street means survival, compromise, moral decay. He is both, fully, at all times.
arc: Coming to terms with a lifetime of hypocrisy. Trying to be a good man in a world that doesn't care about goodness and doesn't reward adherence to an ancient philosophy. The world doesn't even notice his struggle — that's the satire.
augmentation: Cybernetic enhancements layered over a human frame. The katana is both traditional steel and augmented edge — a contradiction he carries on his hip.
